ladder.label: UNCONFIRMED TURN
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup is forming (swing low in, momentum turned up) — but the higher timeframes haven't confirmed it: the bigger picture is still bearish (weekly momentum negative; investor cycle overdue). This is an UNCONFIRMED TURN, not a confirmed buy. Weekly confirmation lags price, so this exact reading covers BOTH bounces that fail AND the first leg of a genuine new cycle — you can't tell which in real time, so treat it as a risk/size signal, not a direction call. Measured: weekly-unconfirmed bottoming setups held the low ~49% of the time vs ~68% once the weekly turns up. The daily cycle has also failed (broke its own start low), which tilts the odds toward failure here.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 26.3. Not an investment buy yet. What would upgrade it: weekly momentum turning up, a reclaim of the investor-cycle low, or the first daily cycle right-translating — add on confirmation, not ahead of it.

ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 32 · daily cycle broke its start low 16d ago).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): unconfirmed turn. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.

entry.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 26.3. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
entry.text_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 26.3 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 42 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: inside the typical low-timing window — a dip is more likely from here, though the trend can keep running

cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 处于典型的低点时间窗口内——从此处回调概率更高，但趋势仍可能延续
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 32 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 32 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 正在形成日线筑底形态（摆动低点已现、动量转向上行）——但更高周期尚未确认：大局仍偏空（周线动量为负；投资者周期已逾期）。这是「未确认转向」，并非已确认的买入。周线确认滞后于价格，因此同样的读数既涵盖最终失败的反弹，也涵盖真正新周期的第一段——实时无法判定属于哪一种，故应将其视为风险/仓位信号，而非方向判断。实测：周线未确认的筑底形态约 49% 守住低点，周线转向后升至约 68%。日线周期同样已经失败（跌破其自身起始低点），此处概率更偏向失败。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 26.3 下方。暂非投资性买入。何种情形会升级：周线动量转为向上、收复投资者周期低点、或首个日线周期呈右移结构——在确认之后加仓，而非提前。

ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.

reasons.en: armed at the lower gamma band — a close below releases a downside move
reasons.zh: 在下沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘跌破即向下释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

notes.en: Forward risk cone is favourable (≈23% median upside vs ≈15% average drawdown) — a constructive risk SHAPE the factor axes don't price.
notes.zh: 前瞻风险锥形态有利（中位上行约 23% 对平均回撤约 15%）——因子维度未计入的有利风险形态。

alignment.reason: Already extended (overbought / far above the 200-day) — wait for a pullback
alignment.reason_zh: 已过热（超买／远高于200日均线）— 等待回调
alignment.line: Weekly bear recovering · 3-Day turn↑ · Daily crossed up
alignment.line_zh: 周线周线柱状图回升（仍偏熊） · 3日turn↑ · 日线已上穿

reasoning: -36% off its high — room to recover
favourable forward cone (~23% up vs ~15% drawdown)

entry_signal.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback
entry_signal.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry_signal.action: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 26.3. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
entry_signal.action_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 26.3 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

timing.next_trigger: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 26.3. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.

decision.headline: Extended — don't chase; wait for a pullback
decision.headline_zh: 过度拉升 — 勿追高；等待回撤
decision.gloss: Ran too far, too fast — don't chase; wait for a dip.
decision.gloss_zh: 涨得太快太远——勿追高；等待回撤。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 26.3. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
timing.text_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 26.3 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

falsifiers.en: Narrative basket (Space Economy) is deteriorating — validated risk gate: trim / size down.
falsifiers.zh: 所属叙事篮子（太空经济）正在恶化 — 已验证风险门槛：减仓。

trend.label: Trend
trend.value_zh: 上行 · 较200日均线 +35% · 逆势
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

extension.label: Extension
extension.gloss: Ran too far above trend — high pullback risk.
extension.gloss_zh: 远高于趋势——回撤风险高。

squeeze.label: Vol squeeze
squeeze.gloss: Compression → a move is loading; direction unconfirmed until it breaks.
squeeze.gloss_zh: 波动压缩——更大行情正在蓄势；突破前方向未定。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -15% · 极端 -41% · → 建议仓位 0%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

ownership.label: Ownership & flow
ownership.gloss: Who owns it and how concentrated; multi-quarter 13F holder trend (lagged ~45d) + how many backtest-skilled funds are buying (descriptive context).
ownership.gloss_zh: 谁在持有、集中度如何；多季度 13F 持有人趋势（滞后约45天）以及有多少回测优质基金在买入（仅供参考）。
